description: Luw.ai Interior AI: redesign an interior photo — home, office, shop, hotel — in any style while keeping the room's architecture. Restyles furniture, materials, colors and lighting. Set empty_room=true to furnish an empty room or turn it into another room type (virtual staging). Costs 1 credit per variation.

empty_room.description: Furnish from scratch / convert the room to room_type (Fill Empty Room mode).

engine.description: Luw.ai model: symphony (Symphony-3, the default: the higher quality) or aria (quicker, for everyday work). If the user picked a model earlier in this conversation, use that one.

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai write the design brief when prompt is empty and there is no style_reference. A written prompt is used as written.

image.description: Photo of the room (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

persona_id.description: Persona whose saved images to use. Its saved styles and room or building type apply unless you send styles or a type.

precision.description: How much to change: 80+ subtly, 50-79 moderately (default 50), under 50 dramatically. Applies when prompt is empty, with style_reference, or when furnishing an empty room.

prompt.description: What you want, in plain language.

reference_images.description: Up to 6 reference images (furniture, materials, products, mood boards) to draw from.

items.description: Reference image (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

room_type.description: Room type, e.g. "Living Room", "Kitchen", "Bedroom", "Home Office" (see luw_list_options kind="interior_types").

style_reference.description: Style-transfer source: an image whose look to copy (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path), or "persona" to use slot 1 of persona_id.

styles.description: Design style names, e.g. ["Scandinavian"]; for Japandi use ["Japanese Design", "Scandinavian"]. Case-sensitive; see luw_list_options.

variations.description: Number of alternative designs (1-4, default 1); each is billed as a generation.

name: luw_interior_design
title: Interior design (Interior AI)
